newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cerus shares suspended limit-up - SBF.
newsitem.headline: Cerus shares suspended limit-up - SBF.

text.p: Shares in holding company Cerus were suspended limit-up on Monday shortly after the bourse opening, the French stockmarkets association SBF said.
An SBF spokeswoman said trading the stock would resume at 0825 GMT with a new ceiling of 137.20 francs.
The newspaper Les Echos reported on Monday that CGIP and Italian industrialist Carlo De Benedetti were trying to negotiate a buyout of Cerus, which owns 28 percent of car parts manufacturer Valeo.
